title: alsine mucronata subsp. rostrata
intro: Alsine mucronata subsp. rostrata, commonly known as Mountain Avens, is a sub-species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, sore throats, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Avens are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and protect the body from external and internal stressors. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Avens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
